The guide documents only current-worktree diagnostics, including in its multi-lane section, while the script exposes --all for cross-worktree provisioning and --lanes [--base <ref>] for ahead/behind, staged/unstaged, and commit-age summaries.

The shared contracts deliberately allow 10,000-character descriptions, but campaign creation, campaign settings, and homebrew collection editing all hard-code maxLength 5000, preventing users from entering otherwise-valid values.

Opened docs/guides/lint-ratchet-adoption.md:62-86,88-147,157-269, examples/lint-ratchet-demo/README.md:88-107, tools/lint-ratchet/README.md:19-33, and the --propose implementation. A broader initializer lacks a stable contract because adopters must choose copy versus dependency, repository-specific globs, output behavior, optional merge rails, and runtime assumptions; leaves 081 and 112 already own the concrete documentation and distribution defects.

Opened eslint-config/package-dependency-configs.js:16-112. The six blocks are three adjacent production/test pairs with differing selectors, package roots, ignores, and devDependency policy; the server production tier also has a unique seed-generator exception at lines 60-65. A factory would replace explicit policy with parameters without eliminating a meaningful drift boundary.

Opened the three files behind the reported 643 lines. The original total improperly combined an unrelated 182-line tRPC reference classifier with a cohesive 461-line expand-barrel resolver. Within the narrower subsystem, export-map.ts maintains whole-graph and per-symbol recursive traversals, export-bindings.ts manually classifies TypeScript declarations, and paths.ts supplies private module resolution.

Opened scripts/codemods/structured-logging-fix.ts, structured-logging-fix-transforms.ts, structured-logging-fix-ast.ts, eslint-rules/structured-logging.js, the codemod import helpers, expand-barrel/import-groups.ts, and leaf 149. The codemod is already split into orchestration, rewrite policy, and AST primitives. The ESLint checks activate as one policy, while the apparent import-normalization overlap is either generic infrastructure already owned by leaf 149 or domain-specific barrel regrouping.

Opened eslint-config/config-surfaces.js:7-77, config-surface-manifest.json:3-129, scripts/lint-coverage-map-check-findings.ts:245-303, and the adoption guide at lines 385-425. Although coverageStatus currently accepts only linted, the field makes each manifest entry's cross-inventory assertion explicit and drives forward mismatch diagnostics. Removing it would merely relocate that invariant into the checker and declarations while causing broad schema, fixture, and documentation churn without a failure mechanism to fix.

promotionCandidates.title: Ad-hoc Fastify tests skip teardown when assertions fail

evidence.note: The rate-limit app is created and readied, then closed only after request execution and the assertion; either failure bypasses close.
The Socket.IO-enabled variant reaches close only after its decorator assertions.
Fastify close is the lifecycle boundary that invokes Socket.IO cleanup.
All six constructions have a tail-position close and no failure-safe per-test cleanup registration.

promotionCandidates.problem: Six app tests create custom Fastify instances but close them only after all requests and assertions. A failure skips teardown; the socket-enabled case also skips its registered Socket.IO cleanup, leaving resources alive during the failure run.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Register every custom instance for per-test cleanup immediately after construction, before ready, injection, or assertions; keep the custom configurations local rather than forcing them through the suite-scoped helper.

priorPackOverlaps.residual: The prior pack landed the failure-safe useTestApp lifecycle for suite-scoped apps, but app.test.ts's custom per-test instances remain outside that lifecycle.

promotionCandidates.title: Three description controls cap valid input at half the shared contract limit

evidence.note: The canonical constant explicitly unifies description fields at 10,000 characters.
Campaign creation and updates validate descriptions against MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH.
Homebrew collection creation and updates use the same 10,000-character contract.
The campaign creation form independently hard-codes maxLength 5000.
The campaign settings form repeats the 5,000-character cap.
The shared create/edit collection control also repeats maxLength 5000.

promotionCandidates.problem: Campaign and homebrew collection authoring surfaces prevent users from entering descriptions longer than 5,000 characters even though their canonical create and update schemas deliberately accept 10,000. The duplicated HTML literals silently make valid input unavailable and can drift again when the shared contract changes.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Use MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH for all three Textarea limits and add focused UI assertions that the controls expose the shared contract.

promotionCandidates.title: Expand-barrel maintains two hand-written traversals of TypeScript's export graph

evidence.note: The codemod manually enumerates variable, function, class, interface, type-alias, and enum declaration forms to identify top-level exports.
One recursive traversal constructs a complete export map with path-stack cycle handling.
A second recursive path resolves one symbol through local, named, namespace, and star re-exports with a separate seen-key scheme.
The feature also maintains restricted module resolution from JavaScript specifiers to ts/tsx files and index modules.

evidence.measurement: 461 total lines across the export graph and binding implementations (`wc -l scripts/codemods/expand-barrel/export-map.ts scripts/codemods/expand-barrel/export-bindings.ts`)
evidence.note: The narrowed barrel-resolution subsystem remains substantial after excluding the unrelated 182-line tRPC identifier classifier.

promotionCandidates.problem: The codemod uses ts-morph but separately models declaration exports, module paths, complete export-map traversal, and single-symbol traversal. TypeScript syntax or resolution changes require synchronized edits across this private semantic machinery, while the graph paths can diverge in alias, star-export, ambiguity, or cycle behavior.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Establish one export-resolution boundary backed where practical by ts-morph or TypeScript semantic APIs. If source-path rewriting requires a custom projection, derive complete-map and single-symbol queries from one memoized traversal.
